setup: Isolated lab (scripts/continuity_lab.py; private HIVERYN_HOME/port under a scratch dir; synthetic workspaces). One terminal architect per provider. The same SQLite state was served in turn by three hiverynd builds: 1195656 (kickoff hidden, as the live daemon was), e0b3eef (kickoff shown, first-seen positions frozen) and this fix. Isolated production build of the POC branch native-order in headless Chromium (Codex at 1280x900, OpenCode at 390x844). Metadata only; no conversation text recorded.

cli.claude: not run natively: the lab login (~/.claude-work) had expired; see claude_recorded_evidence

steps: 1195656: kickoff turn completed, one typed terminal turn (T2)
e0b3eef: kickoff discovered from the native record and appended after T2 (bug reproduced natively, same shape as the live data-load-e2e session)
fix: next native read moved the kickoff before its replies; an open UI reunited the turn by polling alone
fix: one API send per session

moves_on_fix.opencode: only the kickoff got a new revision (placed in the gap before its first reply)
moves_on_fix.codex: stored sequences were consecutive legacy values with no gap before the first reply, so the session was renumbered in one transaction: 9 items each got one new revision, order otherwise unchanged; ids, text and provenance unchanged

ui.markers: order of 'Session kickoff · Launch message' (KICKOFF), the 'not in the record yet' marker (FALSE_MARKER) and typed-input labels in the rendered page

api_send_on_fix.codex: accepted codex_thread_queue 0.09 s; via api, appended after T2 with gapped sequence
api_send_on_fix.opencode: accepted opencode_prompt_async 0.34 s; via api, appended

claude_recorded_evidence: agentruntime adapter/claude history_test: transcript reader yields record order with the kickoff first in its turn and updates in place; daemon docs/evidence/kickoff-visibility-2026-10-28.json: native Claude terminal architect/worker and chat worker had kickoff_first_in_turn true. The ordering fix is in the daemon store and provider-independent; the Claude-specific late-discovery replay was not run natively.
deterministic: store tests (conversation_order_test.go) and sessionruntime TestLateDiscoveredKickoffKeepsNativeOrder use fixture items, not native evidence; the sessionruntime test fails on e0b3eef ([r1 tool1 end1 u2 r2 kick]) and passes on the fix.
notes: After the daemon swap the resumed Codex TUI showed its native 'update available' prompt; it was skipped with Esc in the lab session (no update), after which the queued API input ran.
